content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

A no-KYC payment gateway allows digital creators to transact without revealing personal information, making it easier to sell products like ebooks, courses, and templates. This is crucial in regions where financial institutions often require extensive verification that can exclude many. By leveraging crypto payment processors like NOWPayments, creators can accept payments in various cryptocurrencies while maintaining control over their data and transactions. This infrastructure not only minimizes fees but also enhances privacy, enabling creators to focus on their craft rather than navigating complex financial systems.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC payment system comprises several key components. At its core, tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automate the payment processing and product delivery. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain, triggering an automatic delivery of the digital product directly to the buyer. This entire process occurs in a matter of minutes, ensuring that creators can provide instant access to their offerings. By using decentralized infrastructure, the reliance on traditional banking systems is eliminated, enabling smoother operations for digital sellers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This no-KYC payment gateway infrastructure is designed for digital creators in regions that are often overlooked by mainstream payment platforms. Creators selling digital products, such as ebooks, templates, and software, can benefit immensely from this setup. By adopting this architecture, they gain access to a global market where they can sell without worrying about payment rejections or high fees. This infrastructure is built for those who wish to maintain ownership of their products and customer data while reducing costs associated with traditional payment processors.
Retain 921 USD more at 100 sales per month by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of a no-KYC payment gateway hinges on several integrated components. First, you need a reliable hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which allows for free and accessible online presence. Next, backend logic is facilitated through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, enabling automation of order processing. Together with NOWPayments, which offers low fees and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, these elements create an efficient system for managing digital sales. By combining these free tools, creators can establish a fully functional online store without recurring costs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with this no-KYC payment infrastructure, first, select a hosting platform such as GitHub Pages. Next, set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment processing and automate product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept various cryptocurrencies. Upload your digital products and configure the necessary settings for order management. Finally, promote your store and start selling. For a comprehensive solution that includes all these components, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all necessary blueprints and templates for easy deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe is achievable by utilizing a no-KYC payment gateway. Platforms like NOWPayments allow you to accept cryptocurrencies directly, ensuring that you retain control over your sales and customer data while minimizing fees. This setup empowers you to reach a global audience without the constraints imposed by conventional payment processors.
Accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without the hassle of KYC.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital downloads without platform fees?

By utilizing a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments, you can minimize transaction fees significantly compared to platforms like Gumroad. With a 0.5% fee versus 10% on Gumroad, you retain more profit on each sale.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a wide array of customers. This flexibility ensures that you can accept payments in popular currencies such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT.
Is there a way to automate product delivery?

Yes, using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate product delivery upon payment confirmation. This ensures that customers receive their digital products instantly after completing the transaction.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Absolutely. By leveraging a sovereign digital commerce setup, you can sell templates, fonts, and other digital products without depending on Gumroad or Payhip, thus avoiding their high fees.
What are the benefits of a no-KYC payment gateway?

A no-KYC payment gateway protects your privacy by not requiring personal information. It also reduces fees and allows you to retain complete control over your transactions and customer data, making it ideal for digital creators.
Empower your digital creation journey without relying on traditional payment processors.
